scripts.build: node tools/generate-typst-package.mjs && tsc -p packages/core/tsconfig.json && tsc -p packages/workers/tsconfig.json && tsc -p packages/react/tsconfig.json && tsc -p examples/vite-react/tsconfig.app.json && tsc -p examples/vite-react/tsconfig.node.json && tsc -p examples/pretext-hybrid/tsconfig.app.json && tsc -p examples/pretext-hybrid/tsconfig.node.json
scripts.test: npm run build && node --test packages/core/test/*.test.mjs packages/workers/test/*.test.mjs packages/react/test/*.test.mjs
scripts.pack:core: npm run build && npm pack --workspace packages/core --pack-destination .build
scripts.pack:workers: npm run build && npm pack --workspace packages/workers --pack-destination .build
scripts.pack:react: npm run build && npm pack --workspace packages/react --pack-destination .build
scripts.test:browsers: npm run test:vite && playwright test -c tests/browser
scripts.test:packed: npm run pack:wasm && npm run pack:core && npm run pack:workers && npm run pack:react && node tools/test-packed.mjs
